summary: Premium voices (Petra, etc.) fail to speak on MacOS 26.3 when SC-Voice runs as iPad-on-Mac app. iOS devices work fine. System can use premium voices in native MacOS apps, but iPad compatibility mode apps cannot access them. Need to investigate entitlements, voice availability APIs, and potential Apple limitations for premium voice access in iPad-on-Mac mode.
